title: Scenario pack
description: Operator declaration of one scenario pack: the class map, the annotation vocabulary, extent limits, observer-platform strata, and the named slots a later approval fills. It grants no permission to approach a subject, names no species, and stores no exclusion-zone coordinates. An absent slot is unset. This contract does not fill it.

pack_id.description: Stable name of this pack. The mission pack is aerial-small-objects.

classes.description: Every class this pack can name, each with one stable id.

vocabulary.description: Annotation terms this pack pins. Activity terms are the only list a pack may extend.

limits.description: Minimum extents and extent bins. Null and an empty bin list mean the owner has not set them.

observer_platform_strata.description: Observer platforms this pack reports separately. The values are the recording vocabulary.

access_policy.description: Who may read, tune against or re-score material under this pack. Absent until a custodian records one.

non_disturbance_envelopes.description: Stand-off limits. Absent until a named responsible person approves them. Each entry stores no coordinates.

phase2.description: Declarations from spec sections 19.3 and 19.7. Absent until the owner sets them. Engineering defaults are not stored here.

x-rules.class-ids: Class ids are unique within the pack.
x-rules.class-parents: A parent is another class in this pack. Parent links do not cycle.
x-rules.extent-bins: An empty bin list means the bins are unset. A non-empty list is half-open pixel intervals [min_px, max_px) that partition every extent from 0 upward: the first starts at 0, neighbors meet at an edge, none overlap, none leave a gap, and the last has no upper bound. Bin ids are unique. A bounded bin has max_px greater than min_px.
x-rules.extent-order: When both minimum extents are set, the point extent is less than or equal to the box extent.
x-rules.envelope-order: d_alert_m is at least d_min_m. A sector's elevation_min_deg is at most its elevation_max_deg. Sector ids, zone ids and end conditions are unique within one envelope.
x-rules.envelope-classes: Class ids named by an envelope exist in this pack, are unique within that envelope, and are not repeated across envelopes.
x-rules.phase2-classes: target_set and known_non_targets, when set, each list class ids of this pack once and do not share a class.
x-rules.stand-off-levels: Stand-off levels, when set, strictly increase.

approval.description: The named person and the record that approves a slot. The record is named, not opened.

x-rules.text: Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.
Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.

class-entry.description: One class. Its id is stable. Its display name is not an id.

class_id.description: Stable class id. Distinct from an instance id and a track id.

name.description: Display name. This is not a species list.

x-rules.text: Holds a character other than whitespace: text that is only whitespace is refused.

role.description: scoring classes form the scoring set. distractor and ignore are the pack's distractor and ignore-region policy. unknown is a label status, not a role.

parent_class_id.description: Parent class id, or null when this class is a root.

min_identifiable_extent_px.description: Pixel extent below which reviewers could not identify this class. Absent until the owner sets it.

vocabulary.description: The terms a label may use under this pack. The closed lists are the spec section 4.2 vocabulary, in this order.

visibility.description: Visibility of one instance in one frame.

prefixItems.description: The visible extent can be marked.
Some of the visible extent is hidden.
None of the extent is visible, and the instance is still in the field of view.
The instance has left the recorded field of view.
Confirmed absence in a negative interval.

geometry.description: How a label localizes an instance.

prefixItems.description: A box over the visible extent.
A point, with a reviewed maximum plausible extent when it is scored.
Uncertainty too large for a meaningful location.

non_scoring_mark.description: Mark for an object outside the scoring class set. These terms are not the class roles and are not equated with each other.

prefixItems.description: A real object outside the scoring set.
A region that is not scored.

activity.description: Scenario-specific activity states. Empty until a vocabulary is declared. Image-plane displacement is not a state.

limits.description: Pixel extents used to score and to bin the small-target envelope. Null and an empty list are unset, not a default.

min_box_extent_px.description: A box below this extent is point_only. Null means the owner has not set it.

min_point_extent_px.description: A target below this extent is unlocalizable. Null means the owner has not set it.

extent_bins.description: Bin edges of target extent s_gt = sqrt(w_gt * h_gt), in pixels of the frame the module received. Empty means unset.

extent-bin.description: One half-open pixel interval [min_px, max_px). Null max_px means no upper bound.

max_px.description: Exclusive upper edge, or null when the bin has no upper bound.

access-policy.description: A named access policy. The policy text stays in the approval record.

approach-sector.description: One permitted approach sector. Bearing may wrap. Elevation is the altitude band, in degrees.

bearing_start_deg.description: Start bearing in degrees. 0 and 360 are the same direction.

elevation_min_deg.description: Lower elevation of the altitude band.

elevation_max_deg.description: Upper elevation of the altitude band.

exclusion-zone.description: A restricted zone named by identifier. Coordinates are location-bearing and are not a field of this pack.

zone_id.description: Identifier a report may name. Not a coordinate.

envelope.description: One non-disturbance or collision envelope. Stating it requires an approval record. It is a human judgment, not evidence that a subject was undisturbed.

kind.description: living is a behavioral stand-off for a living subject. collision is a collision-risk stand-off for a drone or other aircraft.

approval.description: Approval by the named responsible person. Required when the envelope is stated.

class_ids.description: Classes this entry covers. Absent leaves that choice to the approval record.

items.description: One class id from this pack.

d_alert_m.description: Inside this range the observer may not close.

approach_sectors.description: Permitted approach directions and elevation band.

exclusion_zones.description: Zones the observer may not enter. Empty means none are declared here.

end_conditions.description: Named conditions that end an encounter.

phase2.description: Phase 2 slots. Each property is absent until the owner sets it.

target_set.description: Fine-grained class ids a declaration may name.

known_non_targets.description: Look-alike class ids a recognizer may be fitted on.

unknown_set.description: Encounters of classes outside this pack are held out of fitting and of threshold choice. Presence declares that set. It names no class.

identifiable_duration_s.description: How long an instance must stay at its identifiable extent to be eligible. The engineering default of 1 second is not stored until the owner sets it.

declaration_deadline_s.description: Time after eligibility by which a declaration is useful. The engineering default of 10 seconds is not stored until the owner sets it.

declaration_burden_per_hour.description: Permitted false declarations per hour of scored exposure. The engineering default of 1 is not stored until the owner sets it.

target_size_m.description: Declared target size used only to turn a simulated range into a pixel extent. It is not a measured size and restates no field result.

stand_off_levels_m.description: Stand-off distances for the mission trade-off, from the minimum outward.
